comment: The lookalike deny list (PB-1168). Data, not code: it ships with the stack and grows each release. `deny` entries are exact package names that impersonate a library Protoboard uses; a hit is reported as `lookalike` and refused by any install or fetch path that consults it (core/src/update/lookalikes.ts checkPackageName). `watch` entries are reported, never refused. `protect` lists the real names; any other name within the edit distance below, with a swapped scope, a -js/.js suffix change, or a wrapper prefix, is reported as a suspected lookalike (a warning that never blocks or deletes). `allow` lists real packages that sit near a protected name. `repos` pins the owner of a GitHub repository Protoboard points people at.

deny.comment: Copies the glTF-Transform CLI description and claims Don McCurdy as author, published by yt540951254. Source: docs/specs/cad-view-research/review-round-1/renderers-and-perf-mechanics.md section 4.1 item 6 (registry.npmjs.org/vaps-transform/latest, read 2026-10-31).

rules.comment: Generic rule (PB-1168 brief, security-updates-telemetry.md section A.4 item 2): names within edit distance 1-2 of a protected name (1 for names under 6 characters), the same base under another scope, a -js or .js suffix added or removed, or <prefix>-<protected base> for bases of 8 characters or more.
